comment: Segue - bar-synced transition looper for a whole drum-machine mix (one sequencer, e.g. a Digitakt at 160 BPM). It follows the kick to count bars and phrases (the first kick after loading is bar 1). Press the footswitch (any press, on or off: the LED means nothing) before the phrase ends: it records the next phrase (Bars bars, mono, 8-bit block floating point, about 15.5 s), and at its end the output jumps to 100 % loop, hiding the sequencer's pattern change. XFade then picks up when turned fully right (LOOP) and fades the live mix back in as you turn it left. Three quick presses delete the loop and reset bar 1 to the next kick. Page 1 Perform: XFade, LoCut (high-pass on the loop only), Roll (beat roll: repeat the current bar, half bar, beat or half beat, in time). Page 2 Loop: Bars, LoBPM, HiBPM (the tracker's tempo range; equal = fixed tempo). Page 3: Thrsh, Listn (tracking only, no effect on the sound), Mode (JUMP / AUTO / MANUAL: what the output does when a loop is ready).
gid_comment: 0x08 = Delay category -> Fx_DLY_. Grouped under DLY with the rest of the pack.
fxid_comment: 480 DualShft, 485 DubSiren, 486 Choral, 487 WaveFold, 488 EuGate, 489 S.GN_L, 490 Scrub, 491 Segue (this pack). Unique inside the repo; check other community effects.

params.name: XFade
params.comment: Crossfade between the live mix (left, LIVE) and the loop (right, LOOP), DJ style: live full from 0 to 50, loop full from 50 to 100, both full at 50. In Mode JUMP and AUTO the output follows its own automatic position right after a loop starts (JUMP: 100 % loop; AUTO: 100 % loop, then a fade back to live) and XFade takes over when it meets that position; in MANUAL it always works. Before the first loop the output is live whatever it says. Default 0 (LIVE).

params.name: LoCut
params.comment: High-pass on the loop only (24 dB per octave): take the loop's kick and bass out while the live mix comes back. OFF, then 21 Hz to 2 kHz (log), shown in Hz. Default OFF.

params.name: Roll
params.comment: OFF, 1BAR, 2BEAT (half a bar), 1BEAT, 1/2BT (half a beat): repeat the slice of the loop that is playing, in time, like a DJ beat roll. Quantized: a change waits for the loop's next bar line. The loop runs on underneath, so turning Roll OFF lands where the loop would have been: bars and phrase never move. Default OFF.

params.name: Bars
params.comment: Phrase and loop length, shown as 1 to 8 bars (screen value + 1). A press waits for the next phrase start (counted in Bars from bar 1). If the bars do not fit in the 15.5 s buffer at the tempo being tracked (8 bars need at least 127 BPM), it records the last 4, 2 or 1 bars of the phrase instead and beeps twice. Default 8.

params.name: LoBPM
params.comment: Slowest tempo the tracker may lock to, 40 to 240 BPM (below 40 reads as 40). With HiBPM it keeps hats, double time and half time from fooling the tracker. Default 160 (with HiBPM 160: a fixed 160 BPM, which tracks best; set your tempo, or open a range for a set that changes tempo).

params.name: HiBPM
params.comment: Fastest tempo the tracker may lock to, 40 to 240 BPM. Set LoBPM and HiBPM equal to fix the tempo (only the beat position is tracked, and kicks pushed off the beat cannot drag it). Default 160.

params.name: Thrsh
params.comment: Tracking only, no effect on the sound. How sudden a jump in the kick band must be to count as a kick: AUTO (starts at 2 x the band's recent level and steps down to 1.7, 1.5, 1.3 x every 4 s until it locks, for boomy kicks), or 1 (1.02 x: soft kicks count, so may bass notes) to 50 (2 x) to 100 (3 x: only hard kicks). Default AUTO.

params.name: Listn
params.comment: Tracking only, no effect on the sound. Where the kick detector listens: a low-pass at AUTO (100 Hz) or 50 to 150 Hz. Lower it if a bassline sits just above the kick. Default AUTO.

params.name: Mode
params.comment: What happens when a loop is ready. JUMP = the output jumps to 100 % loop and stays there until XFade is turned fully right. AUTO = 100 % loop for one loop length, then it fades back to live by itself over the next one; turning XFade takes over once it meets the fade. MANU (manual) = nothing moves on its own, XFade always does what it shows. Default JUMP.

audio_nop_comment: Set true for a UI-only smoke build before trusting the DSP.
